description_en: Calls the RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService operation to remove a user account from the service whitelist of an endpoint service
description_zh: 调用RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService接口，移除终端节点服务的服务白名单
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink remove-user-from-vpc-endpoint-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveUserFromVpcEndpointService

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the endpoint service from which you want to remove the service whitelist. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 要移除服务白名单的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned. The dry run checks whether the AccessKey pair is valid, whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is granted the required permissions (authorization), and whether the required parameters are specified.

false (default): sends a Normal request. If the request passes the check, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the user account is removed from the service whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会移除服务白名单。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接移除服务白名单
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account to remove from the service whitelist
parameters.help_zh: 要移除的服务白名单中的账号ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint service
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The user whitelist in ARN format
parameters.name: user_arn
